name: Inspect component details
content:
Write the knowledge record for component {{runtime.component_name}} in project {{project.id}}. The proposed set is {{task.define_components.output.components}}. Select the one object whose name equals {{runtime.component_name}}. If it is missing or duplicated, fail.

Read that component's evidence under the spokes from see:/projects for this project. Write a present-tense note: responsibility, boundary, current behavior, interfaces, and real source paths. verified_against is spoke@sha for each git spoke you actually read. Do not invent revisions.

Use `item_call` `project` `{{project.id}}` `kind` `knowledge_component` `action` `knowledge_component_list` and `item_fetch` `project` `{{project.id}}` `kind` `knowledge_component` `id` the component id.
- No current record with this name: `item_call` `project` `{{project.id}}` `kind` `knowledge_component` `action` `knowledge_component_create` `arguments` with name and owned_by. Omit id.
- A current record with the same owner and consumers, but a different note or verified_against: `item_fetch` `project` `{{project.id}}` `kind` `knowledge_component` `id` that id, then `item_call` `project` `{{project.id}}` `kind` `knowledge_component` `id` that id `action` `knowledge_component_put` `arguments` with `conflict_token`.
- A current record whose owner or consumers differ: `item_call` `project` `{{project.id}}` `kind` `knowledge_component` `action` `knowledge_component_create` `arguments` with name and owned_by. Omit id.
- An exact match: do not write.

Do not delete records. Do not touch any other component name. The final stdout line is one JSON object with applied (boolean) and id (the written id, or an empty string). Do not use a markdown fence.
